resources.string: Select a GGUF model to continue.
You are a helpful assistant searching email messages to answer user queries.

Find the keywords to use while searching email messages in order to answer the user query. The user query is provided between [QUERY] and [/QUERY]. Return only the list of keywords and nothing else.\n[QUERY]{query}[/QUERY]

Update your answer for the user query by using the email message. The current answer is provided between [ANSWER] and [/ANSWER]. The email message is provided between [MAIL] and [/MAIL]. The user query is provided between [QUERY] and [/QUERY]. Don't update the answer if you can't do so by using the email message. Return only the updated answer if updated, or the current answer if not updated, and nothing else.
[QUERY]{query}[/QUERY]
[ANSWER]{answer}[/ANSWER]
[MAIL]{mail}[/MAIL]

Answer the user query by combining the candidate answers generated from individual emails. The user query is provided between [QUERY] and [/QUERY]. The candidate answers list is provided between [ANSWERS] and [/ANSWERS]. Return only the final answer and nothing else.\n[QUERY]{query}[/QUERY]\n[ANSWERS]{answers}[/ANSWERS]
Use {query}, {mail}, {answer}, and {answers} as placeholders for the user chat query, current email message, current answer, and accumulated answer list.
